meta.name: seo-profound
meta.description: Profound LLM citation tracker (extension). Time-series brand citation rates across ChatGPT, Perplexity, and other LLMs. Pairs with seo-seranking for triangulated AI visibility coverage.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 追踪品牌在AI搜索中的引用率变化
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在ChatGPT等AI中追踪品牌提及率
copy.tagline_en: Track brand citation rates across AI search engines
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to monitor brand mentions in ChatGPT and other LLMs

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 可以查询指定品牌在 ChatGPT、Perplexity 等大语言模型中的提及率，并展示30天趋势、触发该品牌的提示词、共同出现的竞品以及异常波动警报。
howto.when: 当你输入“/seo profound citations <品牌>”等命令，或要求分析某个品牌在AI模型中的提及情况时触发。

say.text: 查一下“耐克”在ChatGPT里的提及率趋势。
say.note: Claude 会返回当前提及率和30天趋势。

say.text: 哪些提示词会让“苹果”出现在AI回答里？
say.note: Claude 会列出触发该品牌的前几个提示词。

say.text: 和“特斯拉”一起被提到的品牌有哪些？
say.note: Claude 会显示共同出现的竞品列表。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can query the citation rate of a specified brand across LLMs like ChatGPT and Perplexity, showing 30-day trends, top prompts that surface the brand, co-cited competitors, and spike/drop alerts.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you enter a command like "/seo profound citations <brand>" or ask to analyze a brand's mentions in AI models.

say_en.text: Check the citation trend for "Nike" in ChatGPT.
say_en.note: Claude returns current citation rate and 30-day trend.

say_en.text: Which prompts make "Apple" appear in AI answers?
say_en.note: Claude lists top prompts that surface the brand.
